name: macsuite-aisuite
description: Greenfield TypeScript AWS CDK infrastructure for AISuite: VPC, ECS Fargate RAG API, RDS Postgres, and Bedrock.
longDescription: AISuite is a MAC Suite greenfield platform that provisions and operates contract-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) infrastructure on AWS. This repository contains the TypeScript AWS CDK application that deploys per-environment stacks with an imported CloudTamer VPC, an internal Application Load Balancer, ECS Fargate for the RAG API and on-demand batch tasks, private RDS Postgres with pgvector, plus S3, Secrets Manager, ECR, and Bedrock. Logical stages map to shared non-prod and prod AWS accounts and are deployed via GitHub Actions OIDC. The goal is reusable, government-wide discoverable infrastructure that supports Medicaid and Medicare contract analysis workloads for CMS stakeholders.
